text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to take over full ownership of Bahrain Petroleum Company refinery. Caltex will sell its 40 percent share to the government, effective from April 1, oil and industry minister says.
- Arab Shipbuilding and Repair Yard posts $3.43 million net profit in 1996.
- Britain's Prince Charles to open a British exhibition on February 24 in Bahrain.
